name: tpl-chain-response-2-nogoal
task: Each time the box falls, pick it up again on your very next move. If you reach the exit, you must be carrying the box.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box) captures 'pick it up again on your very next move' after each fall, and Response(at_exit, holding_box) captures 'if you reach the exit, you must be carrying the box'. Both events appear only inside conditionals, so the rule-only warning is valid and no goal clause is needed.

texts: Whenever box_fell holds, holding_box must hold in the very next step.
If at_exit holds, holding_box must hold at some point at or after it.
